summary: Iteration 3 end-to-end test of Vendor Portal bidding features: (1) Deadline Countdown pill (list + dialog + detail-sheet md size), (2) Auto-Suggest Harga Bid via /price-suggestions endpoint, (3) Multi-file attachment upload + delete, (4) Bid Draft Save vs Submit. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases PASSED (test_iteration3_vendor_bid.py). Frontend: All 4 features visually + interactively verified via Playwright — countdown text 'Sisa 3h 4j' green, price hint 'di atas rata-rata' / 'di bawah rata-rata' rendered, draft persisted with status='draft', re-open showed draft-loaded banner, attachment 'TEST_bid.png' appears in detail sheet as clickable link.

issues: Console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users'. Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for a11y compliance. Non-blocking.
Same Radix a11y warning: missing Description/aria-describedby. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional a11y polish) Add a hidden DialogTitle inside the Submit-Bid dialog and a DialogDescription/SheetDescription to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_vendor_portal.submit_bid: replaces any existing bid (draft or submitted) with the new payload — good. However there is no server-side guard preventing a vendor from re-submitting after tender deadline has passed (only status=='open' is checked). Consider also comparing now() vs tender.deadline.

price-suggestions endpoint scans up to 50 recent POs and iterates items in Python; if the product appears in many historical POs, this is fine but consider Mongo aggregation ($unwind + $group) for large datasets.
VendorPortal.jsx openBid re-fetches suggestions each time (good). Consider caching per tender-id in the session to reduce round-trips on rapid open/close.
Countdown.jsx uses setInterval(1s) which re-renders every second even when tab hidden — acceptable but could pause via document.visibilityState.

attachment upload uses fetch() with Authorization header from localStorage — file check uses UploadFile.size which may be None for streamed uploads; ensure content-length is sent by client (currently fine via FormData).
seed_data_creation: Test bid created for tender 18e7bfb5 (draft then upgraded to submitted with attachment TEST_bid.png).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 Iteration-3 features (Auto-Suggest Harga, Countdown, Attachments, Draft Save) work end-to-end. Only remaining polish is Radix a11y DialogTitle/Description warnings — non-blocking. Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_vendor_bid.py (5 tests). Login as vendor and visit /vendor/tenders; the seeded tender TDR-20260818-BF702 (id 18e7bfb5) has deadline ~3 days from now and 1 historical PO for TEST_Laptop (Rp 15.000.000) which drives the price-suggestions display.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration 3 scope.
